svg.title: L4 Detail -- Three-layer campus network
svg.desc: Traffic from the internet enters at the core layer, which holds the internet gateways, and passes down through distribution to access, where end-stations and servers connect. Redrawn from the three-layer hierarchical network design model described on Wikipedia as Hierarchical internetworking model.
